note: Inflation correction of a mis-based series, not new estimation data. The challenge dataset (data/raw/competition/renewable_energy_dataset.csv) gives GSDP at constant 2011-12 prices from 2011 for the other states, but Jammu and Kashmir's values from 2012 equal MoSPI GSDP at current prices (eSankhyiki National Accounts, 2011-12 series, account type Regional, accessed 2026-11-21; raw copy data/external/macro/raw/mospi_nas/esankhyiki_nas_gsdp_2011_12_20261121.json.gz). Dataset year t = fiscal year t to t+1. Equal to the current-price value, crore INR (constant-price value in brackets): 2012 87138 (80767), 2013 95621 (85102), 2014 98367 (82372), 2015 117168 (97001), 2016 124848 (100203), 2017 139709 (106624), 2018 159859 (115062), 2019 164103 (113919), 2020 167793 (112400), 2021 188561 (115402). 2011 is the base year (78256 at both prices). 2022 to 2024 (220204, 241133, 240580.56) match no MoSPI vintage (the upstream README says missing values were predicted) but are at the current-price level (MoSPI current 209816, 236059, 262358; constant 122640, 133543, 141739), so they are treated as current prices too. The model divides each listed value by the MoSPI national GDP deflator of its fiscal year (2011-12 series, 2011-12 = 100; data/external/macro/price_indices.csv, india_gdp_deflator; official, secondary). Check: 2016 124848 / 1.25052 = 99837 against the MoSPI constant-price value 100203 (-0.4 percent); 2012 to 2021 within -2.0 to +4.2 percent of the MoSPI constant-price values.
